pairs: At this, my heart became frightened,
et emotum est de loco suo.
and it has been moved from its place.
Audite auditionem in terrore vocis ejus,
Pay close attention to the alarm of his voice
et sonum de ore illius procedentem.
and to the sound that proceeds from his mouth.
He beholds everything under the heavens,
et lumen illius super terminos terræ.
and his light reaches beyond the ends of the earth.
After this, a noise will sound;
he will thunder with the voice of his greatness,
and it will not be tracked down,
yet his voice will be obeyed.
Tonabit Deus in voce sua mirabiliter,
God will thunder with his voice miraculously,
for he performs great and unsearchable things.
qui præcipit nivi ut descendat in terram,
He commands the snow to descend on earth,
and the shower of his strength.
qui in manu omnium hominum signat,
He signs the hand of all men,
so that each one may know his works.
The beast will enter his hiding-place,
and he will remain in his cave.
From the interior, a storm will come forth,
and a cold winter from the north.
and the waters are poured forth very widely again.
and the clouds scatter their light.
Quæ lustrant per circuitum, quocumque eas voluntas gubernantis duxerit,
It shines all around, wherever the will of him that governs them will lead,
ad omne quod præceperit illis super faciem orbis terrarum:
to anywhere he will command, over the whole face of the earth,
sive in quocumque loco misericordiæ suæ eas jusserit inveniri.
or in whatever place of his mercy that he will order them to be found.
and consider the wonders of God.
Numquid scis quando præceperit Deus pluviis,
Do you know when God ordered the rains,
so as to show the light of his clouds?
Do you know the great paths of the clouds,
when the south wind blows across the land?
Tu forsitan cum eo fabricatus es cælos,
Perhaps you have made the heavens with him,
qui solidissimi quasi ære fusi sunt.
which are very solid, as if they had been cast from brass.
Reveal to us what we should say to him, for,
of course, we are wrapped in darkness.
Who will explain to him the things that I am saying?
Even while a man is still speaking,
Although they do not see the light,
the air will be thickened suddenly into clouds,
and the wind, passing by, will drive them away.
and fearful praise reaches out to God.
We are not worthy to be able to find him.
et non audebunt contemplari omnes qui sibi videntur esse sapientes.
and all those who seem to themselves to be wise, will not dare to contemplate him.
